heading.title: Of Offences Affecting the Public Health, Safety, Convenience, Decency and Morals

article.title: Conveying person by water for hire in unsafe or overloaded vessel
article.content: Whoever knowingly or negligently conveys, or causes to be conveyed for hire, any person by water in any vessel, when that vessel is in such a state or so loaded as to endanger the life of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both.
article.html:
284Conveying person by water for hire in unsafe or overloaded vessel

Section 284 · Chapter XV

Whoever knowingly or negligently conveys, or causes to be conveyed for hire, any person by water in any vessel, when that vessel is in such a state or so loaded as to endanger the life of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five thousand rupees, or with both.
